subject: Chemistry
title: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
summary: Chemistry particles ko moles mein ginti hai: 1 mol = 6.022 × 10²³ particles (Avogadro's number), aur uska mass grams mein molar mass ke barabar.
Laws of chemical combination (conservation of mass, definite proportions, multiple proportions, Gay-Lussac's law, Avogadro's law) se Dalton's atomic theory bani.
Balanced equation moles mein ek recipe hai. Jo reactant pehle khatam ho wo limiting reagent hai aur wahi product ki maatra tay karta hai.
Concentration mass %, mole fraction, molarity (mol/L, temperature se badalti hai) ya molality (mol/kg solvent, temperature-independent) mein likhte hain.

formulas.name: Mole concept
formulas.formula: n = mass/M = N/Nₐ = V(gas at STP)/22.4 L
formulas.when: Mass, particles aur gas volume ke beech convert karna.
formulas.mistake: 22.4 L sirf STP (273 K, 1 atm) par gas ke liye — liquids ya solids ke liye kabhi nahi.

formulas.name: Atomic mass unit
formulas.formula: 1 amu (u) = 1/12 × mass of one ¹²C atom = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁴ g

formulas.name: Percentage composition
formulas.formula: % of element = (mass of element in 1 mol / molar mass) × 100

formulas.name: Empirical and molecular formula
formulas.formula: molecular formula = n × empirical formula;  n = molar mass / empirical formula mass
formulas.mistake: % ko moles mein badlo, sabse chhote se divide karo, phir whole numbers banao (.5 ya .33 aaye to multiply karo) — seedha round mat karo.

formulas.name: Limiting reagent
formulas.formula: compare (moles available ÷ coefficient) for each reactant — the smallest is limiting
formulas.when: Reactants exact ratio mein na hon tab product ki maatra.
formulas.mistake: Masses compare mat karo — moles ko stoichiometric coefficients se divide karke compare karo.

formulas.name: Mass percent
formulas.formula: w/w % = (mass of solute / mass of solution) × 100;   ppm = (mass of solute / mass of solution) × 10⁶
formulas.when: Mass se concentration; bahut dilute solutions (paani, hawa mein pollutants) ke liye ppm.

formulas.name: Molarity
formulas.formula: M = moles of solute / volume of solution (L)
formulas.mistake: Molarity temperature se badalti hai kyunki volume badalta hai — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Molality
formulas.formula: m = moles of solute / mass of solvent (kg)
formulas.mistake: SOLVENT ka mass lo, solution ka nahi.

formulas.name: Dilution and mixing
formulas.formula: M₁V₁ = M₂V₂;  mixing: M = (M₁V₁ + M₂V₂)/(V₁ + V₂)

formulas.name: Neutralisation (acid–base)
formulas.formula: n₁ × M₁ × V₁ (acid, n = basicity) = n₂ × M₂ × V₂ (base, n = acidity)

examples.title: Atoms ginna
examples.solution: n = 4.4/44 = 0.1 mol; har molecule mein 3 atoms → 0.3 × 6.022 × 10²³ ≈ 1.81 × 10²³ atoms.

examples.title: Limiting reagent
examples.problem: 10 g H₂ 64 g O₂ se react karta hai. Kitna paani banega?
examples.solution: H₂ = 5 mol, O₂ = 2 mol. 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O: O₂ ko 4 mol H₂ chahiye, isliye O₂ limiting → 4 mol H₂O = 72 g (1 mol H₂ bachta hai).

examples.title: Molarity
examples.problem: 0.5 mol NaCl ghol kar 250 mL solution. Molarity?

examples.title: Mass % se molality
examples.solution: 100 g solution: 20 g NaOH = 0.5 mol, 80 g paani mein. m = 0.5/0.080 = 6.25 m.

examples.title: Mole fraction
examples.problem: 46 g ethanol 54 g paani mein. Ethanol ka mole fraction?

examples.title: Titration volume
examples.problem: 50 mL 0.2 M NaOH ko neutralise karne ke liye 0.1 M H₂SO₄ ka volume?

examples.title: Commercial acid ki molarity
examples.problem: H₂SO₄ 49% by mass, density 1.5 g/mL. Molarity?

topics.title: Matter and its classification
topics.explain: Matter ya to pure substance (element ya compound) hai ya mixture (homogeneous jaise hawa ya namak ka ghol; heterogeneous jaise paani mein ret). Compounds ki composition fixed; mixtures ki nahi.

topics.title: Laws of chemical combination
topics.explain: Conservation of mass (Lavoisier); definite proportions (Proust) — compound mein hamesha same elements same mass ratio mein; multiple proportions (Dalton) — ek element ke masses jo doosre ke fixed mass se milte hain chhote whole-number ratio mein (CO aur CO₂); Gay-Lussac — gases simple volume ratios mein milti hain; Avogadro — same T aur P par barabar volume mein barabar molecules.

topics.title: Dalton's atomic theory
topics.explain: Matter indivisible atoms se bana; ek element ke atoms identical; compounds atoms ke fixed ratio mein milne se; reactions atoms ko rearrange karti hain. Baad mein pata chala atoms divisible hain aur isotopes hote hain.

topics.title: Measurement and significant figures
topics.explain: SI units use karo. Answer sahi significant figures mein: × ÷ → sabse kam significant figures; + − → sabse kam decimal places. Scientific notation (N × 10ⁿ) isse saaf karta hai.

topics.title: Stoichiometry in practice
topics.explain: Pehle equation balance karo. Sab kuch moles mein badlo, equation ka mole ratio lagao, phir wapas mass ya volume mein. Percentage yield = (actual/theoretical) × 100.

topics.title: Choosing a concentration unit
topics.explain: Molarity lab mein aasaan par temperature se badalti hai; molality aur mole fraction nahi badalte, isliye colligative properties mein use hote hain. Bahut dilute solutions ke liye ppm = (solute ka mass/solution ka mass) × 10⁶.

ratta: M = mol/L;  m = mol/kg solvent;  x_A + x_B = 1.
Molality and mole fraction don't change with T.
Laws: Lavoisier, Proust, Dalton, Gay-Lussac, Avogadro.
